_comment: form-dutch-field-formats D3: the rule tables the PHP DutchFormatValidator and src/services/dutchFormats.js both read, so the server and the form cannot drift. Same rules as portaliq's DutchFormats. plateSideCodes are the RDW side codes 1 to 14 in order, L a letter and D a digit; from side code plateVowelFreeFrom on, a plate carries none of plateForbiddenLetters. ibanLengths: a known country must match its length; any other country is held to the general shape and the mod-97 check.
